data.animaCaption: Standing before Café Stella's wooden cup shelves in her brown suspender uniform, she holds a folded kraft pastry pouch gently in both hands and offers it toward you with an unusually warm smile. Late-afternoon sunlight and warm shelf bulbs illuminate her dark hair and the fine china behind her.
data.promptProse: Captured at a gentle diagonal before tall wooden display shelves lined with bone-china teacups and coffee canisters in Café Stella, Shiki Natsume wears her canonical white shirt, purple tie, and brown suspender skirt. Cradling a neatly folded kraft pastry pouch in both hands as she offers it toward the viewer, she softens into a sincere, sunlit smile while golden late-afternoon rays through the front glass blend with warm amber shelf lights.
data.story: 傍晚的柔光穿过橱窗落满木质杯架。夏目双手捧着刚装好点的牛皮纸袋递到你面前，神情少有地毫无防备——「刚出炉的司康，凉音姐说给你留了一份。别站在过道发呆，快收下吧。」
